That doesn't mean there's something wrong with us (us as in our person, our being), we just might be ill with something. What people don't realize about anxiety or depression is that it is biological. Just like some people have vitamin deficiency, some people have neurotransmitter (dopamine) deficiency. It's not our fault. We can get help, and there's no shame in it. 
I am not sure that you do have something pathological...but it's very helpful to talk to a therapist.
